### Types

The types the tables below name, from `tenancy/domain.ts`:

```ts
type TenantStatus = "none" | "pending" | "active" | "suspended" | "deleted";

type SuspensionReason = "owner_requested" | "unpaid" | "abuse" | "by_platform" | "rejected";

interface SignUpPolicy {
  /** The status a self-service tenant starts with, or `off`. */
  tenants: "off" | "pending" | "active";
  accounts: "off" | "open";
}

type Owner = { email: string } | { accountId: string };
```

### Aggregates

| Aggregate | Unique keys | Facts |
|---|---|---|
| `tenancy.tenant` | `slug` (global), `owner` | `active`, `exists` |

### Commands

Secret fields leave the vault once the command completes; personal fields stay in the vault until their subject is erased.

| Command | Fields | Writes | Who may send it | Refused with |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ActivateTenant`<br>on `tenant` | — | `TenantActivated` | the platform | `invalid_state` |
| `AddOwner`<br>on `tenant` | `identityId: string` | `OwnerAdded` | owners | `exists`, `invalid_identity`, `not_found`; requires: identity.identity is active |
| `ChangeSignUpPolicy`<br>on `tenant` | `tenants: "off" \| "pending" \| "active"`<br>`accounts: "off" \| "open"` | `SignUpPolicyChanged` | the platform | `invalid_policy`, `not_found`, `platform` |
| `ChangeTenantSlug`<br>on `tenant` | `slug: string` | `TenantSlugChanged` | a group permission | `invalid_slug`, `invalid_state` |
| `CreateTenant`<br>on `tenant` | `slug: string`<br>`name: string`<br>`owner: Owner`<br>`status?: "active" \| "pending"` | `TenantCreated` | any signed-in account (self-service; the platform's groups otherwise) | `exists`, `invalid_name`, `invalid_owner`, `invalid_slug`, `invalid_tenant` |
| `DeleteTenant`<br>on `tenant` | — | `TenantDeleted` | the platform | `invalid_state`, `platform`, `too_early` |
| `ReactivateTenant`<br>on `tenant` | — | `TenantReactivated` | the platform (owners too, after owner_requested) | `invalid_state` |
| `RemoveOwner`<br>on `tenant` | `identityId: string` | `OwnerRemoved` | owners | `last_owner`, `not_found` |
| `RenameTenant`<br>on `tenant` | `name: string` | `TenantRenamed` | a group permission | `invalid_name`, `invalid_state` |
| `RequireMfa`<br>on `tenant` | `required: boolean` | `MfaRequirementChanged` | owners | `invalid_state` |
| `SuspendTenant`<br>on `tenant` | `reason: SuspensionReason` | `TenantSuspended` | the platform (owners too, with owner_requested) | `invalid_reason`, `invalid_state`, `platform` |

### Queries

A query about one aggregate names it (`static target`): the middleware decides on that aggregate as on a command's.

| Query | Fields | About | Answer | Who may ask |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GetTenantBySlug`<br>by `tenancy.tenants` | `slug: string` | — | `{ id: string; name: string; status: TenantStatus }` | the API (its `api` group) |
| `GetSignUpPolicy`<br>by `tenancy.tenants` | — | — | `SignUpPolicy { tenants, accounts }` | the API (its `api` group) |
| `GetTenant`<br>by `tenancy.tenants` | `tenantId: string` | `tenancy.tenant` in `tenantId` | `TenantRow { id, slug, name, status, suspension, mfaRequired, owners }` | a group permission |
| `ListTenants`<br>by `tenancy.tenants` | `status?: TenantStatus`<br>`after?: string`<br>`limit?: number` | — | `{ tenants: TenantRow[]; more: boolean }` | the platform |
